# FLX-3710: the place a fit writes is taken or is not usable

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

fluxsim calibrate --fit --out DIR writes the calibration patch as DIR.patch.json and, when the held-out error holds, the calibrated bundle at DIR. Neither may exist yet, DIR may not be the input bundle or inside it, and its parent directory has to exist. This is checked before the fit starts, so a long fit is never lost to a name that was taken. Choose another --out. Nothing was run.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3710
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
